test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is '**Preferance**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the incorrectly spelled word is '**Preferance**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Preference**'.
 
• It means **'special treatment that you give to one person or group rather than to others'.** [(अन्‍य की अपेक्षा) किसी व्‍यकि्त या समूह के प्रति दिखाई गई कृपा दृष्टि]
 
 
• *Example: When allocating accommodation, we will give **preference** to families with young children*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Preface**: a written introduction to a book that explains what it is about or why it was written. (पुस्‍तक के प्रतिपाद्य का लेखक द्वारा आरंभ में संक्षिप्‍त परिचय; निवेदन, प्रस्‍तावना)
 
• **Predominant**: most noticeable, powerful, or important. (सबसे अधिक दिखाई पड़ने वाला, स्‍पष्‍टतया दर्शनीय, सशक्त या महत्वपूर्ण)
 
• **Predict**: to say that something will happen in the future. [(किसी बात की) भविष्‍यवाणी करना]
